run_viewer_sequence: run the Nymeria viewer CLI to visualize a sequence directory with Rerun 3D output
run_viewer_save_rrd: run the Nymeria viewer CLI with the save flag to export visualization to an RRD file
run_viewer_body_model: run the Nymeria viewer CLI with a specific body model like SMPL or MHR
run_viewer_smpl_model: run the Nymeria viewer CLI with SMPL body model and a custom SMPL model path
review_main_function: review the main CLI entry point that configures logging and launches the Nymeria viewer
